summary.what_it_does: The page is a personal introduction from Mathias Lafeldt, an indie product engineer from Germany. It describes his background: programming since the early 2000s, roughly a decade running production systems on AWS, and a shift toward building products for developers. It lists technologies he is currently focused on, including Rust, Zig, TypeScript, Cloudflare, Astro, and DuckDB. It also says he uses AI across the product lifecycle. He offers freelance engagements from one-time support to long-term product development, and past work includes a website builder, a chaos engineering platform, and a GraphQL-at-the-edge provider. The page text does not contain the postmortem article mentioned in the listing.
